title: Conformal Abstention for Tool-Using LLM Agents with Risk Control
abstract: We study selective prediction for LLM agents that call tools. Using conformal risk control we calibrate an abstention threshold so that the expected error of accepted actions stays below a target level, with finite-sample guarantees.

title: Semantic Entropy Probes for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: We propose an uncertainty quantification method for large language models in RAG pipelines, estimating semantic entropy from hidden states to detect hallucinations.

title: Byzantine-Robust Consensus for Multi-Agent LLM Debate
abstract: Multi-agent debate is vulnerable to adversarial agents. We design a consensus mechanism with reliability guarantees against byzantine LLM agents.

title: Image Classification Calibration with Temperature Scaling for ResNets
abstract: We revisit calibration of convolutional image classifiers on ImageNet.

title: A Faster Sorting Algorithm for GPUs
abstract: We present a GPU radix sort.
